definitions.explanation: The money needed for daily life necessities such as food, housing, and utilities.

examples.japanese: {生活費|せいかつひ}が{足|た}りない。
examples.english: The living expenses are not enough.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}は{生活費|せいかつひ}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: The cost of living in Tokyo is high.

examples.japanese: アルバイトで{稼|かせ}いだお{金|かね}は、ほとんど{生活費|せいかつひ}に{消|き}えてしまう。
examples.english: Almost all the money I earn from my part-time job goes toward living expenses.

notes:
{生活費|せいかつひ} is a compound of {生活|せいかつ} (life, living) + {費|ひ} (expense, cost). The {費|ひ} suffix appears in many expense-related words.

COMPOUNDS:
- {食費|しょくひ}: food expenses
- {交通費|こうつうひ}: transportation costs
- {光熱費|こうねつひ}: utility costs (electricity, gas)
- {家賃|やちん}: rent

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生活費|せいかつひ}を{稼|かせ}ぐ: to earn a living
- {生活費|せいかつひ}を{節約|せつやく}する: to cut living costs
- {生活費|せいかつひ}がかかる: living expenses add up
